zh: 这次我就不加班了。
old_en: I'd rather not work overtime this time.
new_en: I won't work overtime this time.

zh: 这次我就不借给你了，我的车有点问题。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't lend you my car this time; mine is having some issues.
new_en: I can't lend you my car this time, it's having some problems.

zh: 我不方便把车借给你，你看看其他人吧。
old_en: I'd rather not lend you my car this time; you should ask someone else.
new_en: I'm not able to lend you my car, you might want to ask someone else.

zh: 这次我恐怕不能帮你搬家了。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't help you move this time.
new_en: I'm afraid I can't help you move this time.

zh: 恐怕这次不能换座位了，我得坐这里。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't switch seats this time; I need to sit here.
new_en: I'm sorry, I can't switch seats this time, I need to sit here.

zh: 这次恐怕不行，下次吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't come to the party this time, maybe another time.
new_en: I can't make it this time, maybe another time.

zh: 我这就不加班了，孩子放学需要接。
old_en: I'd rather not, as I need to pick up the kids.
new_en: I won't work overtime, I need to pick up my kids.

zh: 这次我就不去了，下次吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't make it this time, maybe another time.
new_en: I can't make it this time, maybe another time.

zh: 恐怕我这次不能参加。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't make it this time.
new_en: I'm afraid I can't make it this time.

zh: 这次我恐怕不能接电话，改天吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't answer the phone right now, maybe another time.
new_en: I can't answer the phone this time, let's try another day.

zh: 这个时间我恐怕不行，换个时间再打过来吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't make it at this time, maybe another time instead.
new_en: I'm afraid I can't do it at this time, let's try another time.

zh: 恐怕这次帮不了这个忙。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't help this time.
new_en: I'm afraid I can't help this time.

zh: 这次我就不换了，给你留着吧。
old_en: I'd rather not change it this time, maybe another time.
new_en: I'll keep it the same this time, you can use it.

zh: 这次我就不先付全款了，下次吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't pay the full amount this time; maybe another time.
new_en: I can't pay the full amount this time, let's do it next time.

zh: 恐怕这次不能先付全款，还是等下次吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't pay in full this time; maybe another time.
new_en: I can't pay in full this time, let's wait until next time.

zh: 这次我恐怕不能陪你再吃一块蛋糕了，下次吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't eat another piece of cake with you this time, maybe another time.
new_en: I can't have another piece of cake with you this time, let's do it next time.

zh: 这次我真的不好意思再吃一块蛋糕了，改天吧。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't eat another piece of cake today, maybe another time.
new_en: I can't eat another piece of cake this time, let's do it another day.

zh: 这次我恐怕不能加班了，家里有点事。
old_en: I'm afraid I can't stay late tonight, I have something at home.
new_en: I can't stay late this time, I have something at home.

zh: 这次我就不参加了，改天吧。
old_en: I'd rather not, maybe another time.
new_en: I won't join this time, let's do it another day.

zh: 这次我就不去了，你先走吧。
old_en: I'd rather not, you can go first.
new_en: I won't go this time, you can leave first.
